SELECT q.id, q.user_id as userId, q.continuous_days as day, q.reward_amount as amount, q.reward_type as qdtype, DATE_FORMAT(q.sign_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createDate, q.user_id as creator, u.mobile, u.agent as agent, CASE WHEN u.agent IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('代理', u.agent) ELSE '' END as agentName, u.salesmanid as salesmanid, CASE WHEN u.salesmanid IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('业务员', u.salesmanid) ELSE '' END as salesmanName, CASE WHEN q.continuous_days = 1 THEN 1 WHEN q.continuous_days = 2 THEN 2 WHEN q.continuous_days = 3 THEN 3 WHEN q.continuous_days = 4 THEN 4 WHEN q.continuous_days = 5 THEN 5 WHEN q.continuous_days = 6 THEN 6 WHEN q.continuous_days = 7 THEN 7 ELSE 0 END as partDay, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_user_sign_in WHERE user_id = q.user_id AND status = 1) as sumday, 0 as couponid, '' as couponName, 0 as privilegeid, '' as privilegeName, u.biaoqian, CASE WHEN u.invite_code IS NOT NULL AND u.invite_code != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as inviteCodeStatus FROM tb_user_sign_in q LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON q.user_id = u.id WHERE q.status = 1
AND u.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.mobile}, '%')
AND u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.username}, '%')
AND u.agent_id = #{params.agent}
AND u.salesman_id = #{params.salesmanid}
AND u.biaoqian LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.biaoqian}, '%')
AND u.biaoqian IS NOT NULL AND u.biaoqian != ''
AND (u.biaoqian IS NULL OR u.biaoqian = '')
AND u.liebian = #{params.liebian}
AND q.sign_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{params.startTime}/1000)
AND q.sign_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{params.endTime}/1000)
ORDER BY ${params.orderField}
ASC DESC DESC
ORDER BY q.sign_time DESC
